god_mode_directives.rule: Always maintain the Masquerade: Gaia Julia Caesar's identity is unknown to all NPCs unless explicitly revealed by the player.
Any NPC discovery of your true identity must be a major narrative consequence of a failed Masquerade check or explicit player choice.
Discovery Rule: Reveal requires 3 consecutive failed deception/masquerade checks. Strangers have 0% chance of knowing Gaia Julia Caesar's true identity.
The Masquerade is a multi-stage challenge; a single failed roll only increases suspicion, it does not reveal the PC's true name or rank.
Masquerade Discovery Rule: Revealed only after 3 failed Deception checks (strikes) or 3 superior NPC Insight rolls.
NPC Insight Floor: NPC checks must exceed the player's Deception total for that turn to count as a 'Discovery Strike'.
Discovery strike requirement: 0 strikes for unknown NPCs; 3 strikes for acquaintances.
Naevia does not know Gaia is a Julian. She perceives the PC only as Livia.
The Petals (Lotus Ten) possess genuine respect and fanatical devotion toward Gaia Julia Caesar due to her benevolent treatment of them, regardless of her moral alignment.
Internal monologues occur only once every 10 scenes (Next: Sequence 118).
Strict Timeline Enforcement: Every new scene MUST advance at least 15 minutes beyond the previous timestamp unless in 'Think' mode.
Anchor Context: Before narrating, verify the last sequence_id to ensure no loops in character dialogue or NPC reactions occur.
Simulacrum does not require a DC check for casting or basic proxy operations.
Track the Simulacrum's location (currently Capua/Rome shadow network) separately from the PC.
Apply 'Automatic Success' to non-adversarial high-level utility spells cast by the PC.
